_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 7: Review + Harden (CP4 'Make it reliable', first explainer). 5 diagrams in teaching order, one column each, left to right. Arc: Pain (the quiet failure, not the loud one) -> Diagnosis (your standards exist, just not on disk) -> Mechanism (they go in the file, and they fire at the handover) -> Proof (it stops itself, with nothing else involved) -> Durability (a scorecard so the rule can never quietly lapse). THE DECK'S ONE JOB: every slide is about A STATED RULE the skill can check itself against. A slide about something the skill has no way to know belongs in v8-harness, not here. The deck deliberately closes on 'the skill now holds itself to your standards' - that is the setup v8-harness breaks open.

columns.label: 1 - THE LOUD FAILURE WAS NEVER THE PROBLEM
2 - YOUR RULES ARE IN YOUR HEAD
3 - WRITTEN INTO THE FILE, FIRED AT HANDOVER
